records.translation: echos/-1000 -1000/farmer 13 23 2 Penny 9 29 1/swimming farmer/swimming Penny/skippable/showFrame Penny 31/viewport 13 27 true/pause 2000/playSound slosh/move farmer 0 6 3/positionOffset farmer 0 16/pause 700/speak Penny "你來了……我還擔心你沒收到紙條。$6"/playSound slosh/move Penny 1 0 1/pause 1500/faceDirection Penny 0/speak Penny "看來这里只有我們兩個。$8"/pause 800/speak Penny "夜裡在外面受凍後泡進水裡，感覺真舒服，對吧？$6"/faceDirection farmer 0/pause 1300/faceDirection Penny 1/pause 500/playSound slosh/move Penny 1 0 1/faceDirection farmer 3/speak Penny "$q -1 null#知道我今晚為什麼約你來嗎？$8#$r -1 0 event_pool1#你有話想告訴我。#$r -1 0 event_pool2#我不太確定。#$r -1 0 event_pool3#你想看我穿泳裝。"/faceDirection Penny 3/pause 800/faceDirection Penny 1/speak Penny "呃，該怎麼說呢……$8"/pause 1000/playSound slosh/move Penny 1 0 1/pause 500/speak Penny "我已經想告訴你一陣子了……關於自己的感受。$8#$b#我一直無法停止想你……$8#$b#我從沒對任何人有過這種感覺。$8"/speak Penny "$q -1 null#……$8#$r -1 0 event_pool4#我對你也有同樣的感覺。#$r -1 -1500 event_pool5#對不起，但我並不是那樣喜歡你……"/fork pennyHeartbroken/pause 1000/showFrame Penny 32/pause 200/playSound slosh/positionOffset Penny 2 0/pause 50/positionOffset Penny 2 0/pause 50/positionOffset Penny 2 0/pause 50/positionOffset Penny 2 0/positionOffset farmer -2 0/pause 50/positionOffset Penny 2 0/positionOffset farmer -2 0/pause 50/eyes 1 -10000/positionOffset Penny 2 0/positionOffset farmer -2 2/pause 50/positionOffset Penny 2 0/positionOffset farmer -2 0/pause 50/positionOffset Penny 2 0/positionOffset farmer -2 0/pause 50/positionOffset Penny 2 0/positionOffset farmer -2 0/pause 50/positionOffset Penny 2 0/positionOffset farmer -2 0/specificTemporarySprite heart 13 29/pause 1200/globalFade/viewport -1000 -1000/pause 2000/stopSwimming farmer/stopSwimming Penny/end warpOut

shaneTheme/-2000 -2000/farmer 18 18 1 Marnie 21 14 0 Jas 25 16 2 Shane -1000 -1000 2/skippable/specificTemporarySprite shanePassedOut/viewport 22 8 true/pause 2000/speak Marnie "謝恩？"/pause 2000/doAction 21 13/pause 500/move Marnie 0 -7 1/textAboveHead Marnie "哦，天啊……"/doAction 21 13/removeTile 21 13 Buildings/removeTile 21 12 Front/move farmer 3 0 0/faceDirection Jas 3 true/move farmer 0 -10 1/faceDirection Marnie 2/pause 500/speak Marnie "@……能做點什麼嗎？他完全昏過去了。$s"/pause 500/faceDirection farmer 0/pause 500/faceDirection farmer 1/move farmer 3 0 0/faceDirection Marnie 1 true/move farmer 0 -1 1/pause 1000/speak Shane "呃啊……$7"/pause 2000/specificTemporarySprite waterShane/pause 250/playSound wateringCan/pause 1000/specificTemporarySprite waterShaneDone/warp Shane 25 7/textAboveHead Shane "什……？！"/jump Shane/shake Shane 2000/showFrame Shane 18/pause 3000/showFrame Shane 0/move farmer -1 0 1/faceDirection Shane 3/speak Marnie "謝恩！你到底怎麼了？現在除了躲在房間裡悶悶不樂和喝啤酒，什麼都不做！$s"/move Jas -4 0 0 true/pause 200/faceDirection Shane 2 true/pause 50/faceDirection Shane 1/emote Shane 12/shake Shane 1000/textAboveHead Shane "……"/pause 1500/speak Shane "你不會明白的……"/pause 1000/textAboveHead Marnie "我很擔心……"/move Jas 0 -8 1/speak Marnie "你有什麼打算？從來沒想過未來嗎？"/faceDirection Shane 0/textAboveHead Shane "打算？"/pause 2000/speak Shane "希望我不會活到需要什麼「打算」的時候……"/jump Jas/pause 500/shake Jas 10000/speed Jas 4/textAboveHead Jas "……*啜泣*……"/move Jas 0 10 2 true/faceDirection Marnie 2/emote Marnie 28 true/faceDirection farmer 3/faceDirection Shane 1 true/pause 50/faceDirection Shane 2/pause 600/move Marnie 0 10 2 true/pause 1000/textAboveHead Shane "賈斯……"/pause 500/faceDirection farmer 1/pause 400/showFrame Shane 19/pause 1000/textAboveHead Shane "對不起……"/pause 3000/faceDirection Shane 1 true/showFrame Shane 4/pause 500/showFrame Shane 35/playSound thudStep/shake Shane 4000/pause 2000/end

pause 100/speak Sam "大家好。我們來自鵜鶘鎮……呃……樂團叫作「哥布林毀滅者」。$8"/speak Sam "$p 20#這首歌講的是耕種、採礦和伐木。|$p 8820#這首歌講的是海中城市。|$p 8821#這首歌講的是火車。|開始吧……$8"/playMusic samBand/animate Abigail false true 125 49 34 35 48/pause 2500/animate Sam false true 250 20 21/animate Sebastian false true 125 42 43 52 53/animate Vincent false true 250 20 8 21 8/animate Emily false true 250 16 17/animate Leah false true 250 30 31/animate Elliott false true 250 36 37/animate Maru false true 250 29 30/pause 31500/jump Sam/pause 500/animate Sam false true 236 22 23/pause 15000/stopAnimation Sam/stopAnimation Sebastian/stopAnimation Abigail/pause 700/animate Abigail false true 250 49 34 35 48/animate Sam false true 500 20 21/animate Sebastian false true 250 42 43 52 53/pause 10000/stopAnimation Sam/stopAnimation Sebastian/stopAnimation Abigail/pause 800/stopAnimation Vincent/stopAnimation Elliott/stopAnimation Leah/stopAnimation Maru/stopAnimation Emily/speak Emily "$p 78#哇！那些電子音效太迷幻了！$h|嗚呼！真是太棒了！$h"/speak Leah "$p 79#太棒了！這是一首新的酒館鄉村經典！|大家做得好！$h"/speak Shane "$p 77#我非常喜歡結尾那段沉重的驟停。|我很喜歡那段貝斯。"/move Sam 1 0 2/speak Sam "謝謝大家！$h#$b#但你們真正該鼓掌的人是@！沒有${his^her}$的幫助，我們一開始根本無法決定要做哪種音樂！"/faceDirection Sam 2/faceDirection Leah 3/faceDirection Penny 1/faceDirection farmer 3/speak Penny "所以你算是樂團的榮譽成員囉？$h"/pause 300/faceDirection Penny 0 true/faceDirection Leah 0/faceDirection farmer 0 true/move Sam -1 0 2/speak Sam "哦！出去時別忘了拿一卷我們的試聽帶……只要10金！"/pause 1000/mail afterSamShow/globalFade/viewport -1000 -1000/pause 4000/speak Sam "進行得很順利！再次謝謝你和我們一起來。$h"/end dialogue Sam "嘿，演出非常成功！再次謝謝你，@。"

sadpiano/-1000 -1000/farmer 7 9 0 Leah 13 8 0/skippable/showFrame Leah 20/changeMapTile Front 14 7 1453/viewport 12 8/move farmer 0 -1 1/speak Leah "凱爾……到底要說幾次？我不想回城市！$8#$b#別再打電話……我再也不想聽到你的消息！*喀嚓*$8"/playSound openBox/faceDirection Leah 1/changeMapTile Front 14 7 1454/emote Leah 12/pause 1000/move farmer 4 0 1/faceDirection Leah 3/speak Leah "@……$6"/pause 300/emote Leah 28/speak Leah "所以我想，你聽到我在電話裡大吼了？$s"/faceDirection Leah 2/move farmer 1 0 1/pause 1000/playMusic desolate/speak Leah "那是我的前任……$s"/faceDirection Leah 3/emote farmer 16/pause 600/speak Leah "看來最好稍微告訴你這件事……$u"/pause 500/faceDirection Leah 2/pause 500/speak Leah "以前我們在城市裡同住一間公寓。$u#$b#我白天打零工，整晚創作藝術……賺的錢只夠勉強過活。$u#$b#${He^She}$總是嘮叨，要我回學校念商業或醫學……讀些能賺大錢的科系。$a#$b#我想對方的想法是存錢過上正常生活。你知道……郊區的房子、孩子、家長會……之類的。$u"/faceDirection Leah 3/speak Leah "@，我還沒準備好過那種生活……我非走不可。所以才來到這裡追求成為藝術家的夢想。"/pause 900/faceDirection Leah 2/speak Leah "$q 83 null#@，我那樣做很自私嗎？$s#$r 83 0 event_parents1#不，那是非做不可的事。#$r 83 0 event_parents2#不，而且你的前任聽起來像個白癡。#$r 83 -20 event_parents3#不，但留在城市裡會對你更好。#$r 83 -20 event_parents4#對，有一點。#$r 83 -20 event_parents5#對，但先關心自己是很自然的事。"/faceDirection Leah 3/fork angry/pause 200/fork LeahInternet internet2/fork LeahArtShowSuggestion artShowSuggest/speak Leah "總之，謝謝你聽我說。有個朋友真好。"/pause 1500/globalFade/viewport -1000 -1000/end dialogueWarpOut Leah "嘿，謝謝你之前那麼有耐心地聽我說。"

distantBanjo/-1000 -1000/farmer -100 -100 02 Gus 10 21 2 Willy 13 21 3 Lewis 8 22 1 Robin 9 20 2 Pam 11 20 2 Marnie 9 23 0/skippable/specificTemporarySprite staticSprite LooseSprites\\Cursors2 145 193 32 28 10 20.75 8 .15/viewport 11 21 true/pause 3000/speak Gus "好了，各位……我們再次為一個非常特別的場合齊聚一堂。"/pause 500/speak Gus "……一位摯友難得的造訪……"/pause 500/jump Gus/pause 400/speak Gus "……我名揚世界的巨型歐姆蛋！$h#$b#辛香甜椒、多汁番茄、濃郁蘑菇和酸香起司……全都裹在香濃鬆軟的蛋皮裡。各位，開動吧。"/move Marnie 1 0 0/move Willy -1 0 3/move Lewis 1 0 1/showFrame Lewis 28/playSound coin/showFrame Willy 32/showFrame Robin 37/showFrame Pam 36/pause 600/shake Lewis 600/playSound eat/pause 600/shake Pam 600/playSound eat/pause 800/shake Robin 600/playSound eat/pause 600/shake Pam 400/playSound eat/pause 700/faceDirection Gus 1/speak Gus "威利？你覺得怎麼樣？"/pause 400/textAboveHead Willy "嗯……"/pause 700/shake Willy 400/playSound eat/pause 600/shake Willy 400/playSound eat/pause 600/speak Willy "蘑菇比去年稍微更有嚼勁……"/pause 400/speak Gus "這是好事嗎？$s"/pause 400/playSound eat/shake Willy 400/pause 600/playSound eat/shake Willy 400/pause 600/playSound eat/shake Willy 400/pause 800/playSound gulp/pause 1300/textAboveHead Willy "是啊，小伙子"/pause 300/jump Gus/pause 400/emote Gus 32/pause 1000/speak Pam "很好吃，格斯。而且因為不用付錢，味道更棒了！$h"/faceDirection Gus 2/speak Robin "這些蛋的味道真濃，顏色又黃……瑪妮，是你那裡的蛋嗎？"/faceDirection Gus 3/speak Gus "不是……要感謝%farm農場的@！"/emote Lewis 20 true/emote Marnie 20 true/emote Robin 20 true/emote Pam 20 true/emote Willy 20 true/pause 1000/speak Marnie "嗯……%farm的蛋。"/pause 200/textAboveHead Lewis "嗯唔……"/faceDirection Gus 2/viewport move 1 0 7000/pause 500/playSound eat/shake Robin 400/pause 1000/playSound eat/shake Lewis 400/pause 1000/playSound eat/shake Marnie 400/pause 1000/fade/viewport -1000 -1000/end

spring_day_ambient/-1000 -1000/farmer 12 27 1 Sebastian 18 26 2/skippable/specificTemporarySprite sebastianGarage/showFrame Sebastian 33/animate Sebastian false true 100 32 32 32 36 32 32 36 36 36 36/positionOffset Sebastian 24 16/viewport 18 25 clamp true/move farmer 5 0 0/playSound clank/move farmer 0 -1 1/pause 100/playSound clank/pause 600/playSound clank/pause 300/playSound clank/pause 800/stopAnimation Sebastian/showFrame Sebastian 35/animate Sebastian false false 100 32 33 34 35/playSound dwoop/pause 500/speak Sebastian "哦，你好，@。$8"/pause 800/faceDirection farmer 0/emote farmer 8/pause 400/speak Sebastian "怎麼，你以前沒看過我的摩托車？嗯……看來我沒給你看過。$8"/pause 900/showFrame Sebastian 32/animate Sebastian false false 100 35 34 33 32/pause 500/faceDirection farmer 1/animate Sebastian false true 200 32 32 32 36 32 32 36 36 36/pause 600/playSound clank/pause 600/playSound clank/pause 300/pause 800/playSound parry/pause 800/playSound clank/playMusic echos/pause 2000/glow 80 70 255 true/pause 1000/speak Sebastian "有時日落後，我會騎上一大段路，離開星露谷……$8"/pause 800/speak Sebastian "在空蕩的道路上飛馳，奔向城市微弱的燈光……沒有任何事能與之相比。$9"/pause 200/playSound clank/pause 500/playSound clank/pause 200/speak Sebastian "等存夠錢，我就要獨自出發……前往城市和更遠的地方。只有我和摩托車。$9"/pause 900/playSound clank/pause 900/stopAnimation Sebastian/playSound Milking/pause 1500/stopGlowing/playMusic spring_day_ambient/speak Sebastian "好了，機油換完了。$8"/pause 1200/showFrame Sebastian 35/animate Sebastian false false 100 32 33 34 35/playSound dwoop/pause 1900/speak Sebastian "$q -1 null#嘿……你想的話，也許哪天可以讓你騎騎看。$8^嘿……也許哪天可以載你去兜風。$8#$r -1 10 event_garage1#聽起來很好玩。#$r -1 -10 event_garage2#不，謝了。聽起來很蠢。#$r -1 0 event_garage3#我怕摩托車。"/pause 900/viewport move 1 -1 8000/pause 4000/globalFade/viewport -1000 -1000/end

nightTime/-1000 -1000/farmer 23 29 3 Maru 14 29 3/skippable/changeToTemporaryMap NightSceneMaruMap2 false/bgColor 0 0 0/ambientLight 0 0 0/viewport 14 25 true clamp/pause 1000/move farmer -8 0 3/faceDirection Maru 1/pause 800/showFrame Maru 32/pause 700/showFrame Maru 4/speak Maru "嘿，@。你來得正是時候……彗星就要出現了。"/pause 500/faceDirection Maru 2/pause 1000/faceDirection farmer 2/pause 1000/speak Maru "今晚很美，對吧？"/pause 2000/faceDirection Maru 1/faceDirection farmer 3/pause 1000/speak Maru "還記得我們第一次這麼做嗎？已經有一段時間了……"/faceDirection Maru 2/speak Maru "那天晚上，我差點說出真實的感受……但很怕遭到你拒絕。"/faceDirection Maru 1/speak Maru "誰能想到我們沒過多久就結婚了！$h"/pause 500/emote farmer 20/pause 500/jump Maru/pause 400/speak Maru "哦！時間到了……"/faceDirection Maru 3/faceDirection farmer 3 true/showFrame Maru 28/emote Maru 40/pause 1000/textAboveHead Maru "哇！"/pause 3000/showFrame Maru 12/move Maru 0 1 0/speak Maru "快看！"/pause 500/move farmer -1 0 3/pause 1000/animate farmer true true 100 35/pause 1000/fade/viewport -1000 -1000/pause 1000/playMusic spaceMusic/warp Maru 15 29/faceDirection Maru 3/cutscene marucomet/pause 1000/viewport 14 25 true clamp/pause 3000/stopAnimation farmer/pause 1000/faceDirection farmer 1/pause 500/speak Maru "看見彗星後，依照慣例要許個願……"/pause 500/quickQuestion 你要許什麼願？#有個新寶寶#一起白頭偕老#更多錢(break)jump Maru\pause 500\speak Maru "哦！我們當然可以試試……$l"\emote Maru 20(break)emote Maru 20\speak Maru "那……真甜蜜！$l#$b#我的願望也一樣。$l"(break)speak Maru "錢？哦……$s#$b#嗯，我想這確實很實際……$8"\emote Maru 28\speak Maru "我的願望浪漫多了……"/pause 2000/animate Maru false true 100 28/animate farmer false true 100 101/positionOffset farmer 16 0/specificTemporarySprite heart 15 29/pause 2000/specificTemporarySprite maruTelescope/viewport move 0 -1 13000/pause 16000/fade/viewport -1000 -1000/pause 3000/end newDay

playful/11 20/farmer 14 24 0 Elliott -30 -30 0 Clint 18 22 2 Marnie 9 22 3 Pam 7 18 1 Lewis 8 22 1 Pierre 4 22 2 Demetrius 3 23 1 Gus 14 18 2 Emily 16 18 3/skippable/move farmer 0 -3 3/faceDirection Pierre 1 true/move farmer -3 0 0/faceDirection Pierre 2 true/move farmer 0 -1 0/faceDirection Marnie 0 true/faceDirection Gus 3/speak Gus "你好。稍等一下，我馬上替你點餐。"/faceDirection Gus 2/move Emily 2 0 1/faceDirection Marnie 3 true/pause 800/move Emily -2 0 0/pause 1000/faceDirection Clint 3 true/move Emily 2 0 1/warp Elliott 14 24/playSound doorClose/pause 500/move Elliott 0 -3 3/faceDirection farmer 2 true/move Elliott -2 0 0/move Elliott 0 -1 0/faceDirection farmer 1/faceDirection Elliott 3/speak Elliott "你好，@！真是愉快的驚喜！#$b#我剛完成8小時的寫作，來這裡放鬆一下。$h"/pause 400/faceDirection Elliott 1/speak Elliott "酒保！請來兩杯最好的麥芽酒！^酒保！替我拿最好的麥芽酒，再替這位女士拿杯葡萄酒！"/faceDirection Gus 3/faceDirection farmer 0/speak Gus "……$u"/move Gus 3 0 0/move Gus 0 -1 0/faceDirection Emily 2/playSound openBox/pause 400/playSound Milking/move Pam -6 0 0/move Gus 0 1 3/move Gus -5 0 2/faceDirection Elliott 0/pause 500/speak Gus "來了，先生。$u"/pause 500/faceDirection Elliott 3/faceDirection farmer 1/speak Elliott "$q 28376 null#慢著。我提議乾一杯！敬……#$r 28376 25 event_toast4#敬鵜鶘鎮！#$r 28376 50 event_toast2#敬我們的友誼！#$r 28376 -10 event_toast1#敬我的健康！#$r 28376 -50 event_toast3#敬你的末日！"/faceDirection Elliott 2/faceDirection farmer 2/pause 900/showFrame Elliott 16/animate Elliott false false 120 16 17 18 19 19 18 18 19 19 18 18 19 19 18 18 19 19 18 18 17 16/pause 500/farmerEat 346/pause 900/pause 1100/stopAnimation farmer/faceDirection farmer 1/speak Elliott "*嗝*……好烈的酒……$h"/pause 800/animate Elliott false false 400 20 21 22 21 20 21 22 21 20 21 22 21 20 21 22 21 16/pause 1000/faceDirection farmer 1/pause 800/faceDirection farmer 2/animate farmer false true 100 102 103/pause 1000/globalFade/viewport -1000 -1000/pause 600/stopAnimation farmer/end warpOut

distantBanjo/-100 -100/farmer 31 20 0 Alex 32 7 0 Shane 33 8 0 Gus 34 8 0 Kent 35 8 0 George 36 7 0/skippable/specificTemporarySprite gridballGameTV/viewport 34 7 true/move farmer 0 -13 1 true/pause 1000/textAboveHead Alex "關鍵一球！"/pause 600/jump Gus/pause 2000/textAboveHead George "得分！"/pause 400/textAboveHead Alex "就是這樣！"/faceDirection Kent 3 true/faceDirection Gus 1 true/animate Gus false true 100 22/animate Kent false true 100 17/shake Gus 500/shake Kent 500/pause 500/textAboveHead George "好小子！"/pause 1000/stopAnimation Gus/stopAnimation Kent/faceDirection Kent 0 true/faceDirection Gus 0/pause 1000/faceDirection Alex 3/pause 400/speak Alex "嘿，@！你來了！$h"/faceDirection Alex 1/speak Alex "所以……你覺得怎麼樣？"/pause 500/emote farmer 8/faceDirection Alex 3/speak Alex "我一直在想……知道我以前怎麼夢想有一天成為運動員吧？#$b#嗯，人生最後走上了一條有點不同的路……$9#$b#不過我很幸福，別誤會！$h#$b#……但我想，如果有個地方讓我們這些男人聚在一起看星期日的比賽，應該很酷。格斯非常喜歡這個點子，甚至把後面的一部分房間提供給我！#$b#這樣一來，我就能以小小的方式保留一部分「夢想」。"/pause 500/emote farmer 32/pause 600/faceDirection George 3/speak George "你做得很好，孩子。我本來可以在家看，但來這裡讓我覺得自己又年輕了！$h"/faceDirection Alex 1/speak Alex "謝謝，爺爺。"/pause 500/speak Kent "我很高興有個理由可以出門，暫時忘掉那些事。"/faceDirection Alex 2/pause 100/textAboveHead Shane "我也是"/pause 1200/speak Gus "我玩得很開心，而且對生意也有幫助！$h#$b#雖然對謝恩的肝可能不太好……$s"/pause 100/faceDirection Shane 2 true/animate Shane false true 100 18/jump Shane/pause 500/textAboveHead Shane "嘿！"/pause 500/emote Alex 32/pause 2000/fade/viewport -1000 -1000/pause 400/message "看來男士們有了新的星期日傳統。"/pause 1000/message "這5,000金花得很值得！"/pause 1000/end dialogue Alex "再次謝謝你給錢，@。這是個很好玩的計畫，而且所有人看起來都很滿意！"

Hospital_Ambient/-100 -100/farmer -200 -2000 0 Harvey 4 5 0/skippable/changeLocation HarveyRoom/showFrame Harvey 23/viewport 5 6 true/pause 1000/speak Harvey "喂？喂？有人收聽嗎？$9"/pause 1300/emote Harvey 40/speak Harvey "這裡是H醫生……北緯52度，東經43.5度……請求空中回應……有人收聽嗎？$9"/pause 2000/emote Harvey 40/pause 700/playSound newArtifact/message "收到……地面的H醫生……這裡是祖祖黑鳥55。有什麼要報告嗎？"/showFrame Harvey 28/jump Harvey/pause 800/speak Harvey "真的有人？！$10#$b#呃……我是說！……標準地面報告：風速3節，西偏北36度。地面溫度42克拉格。溼度53%。H醫生通訊完畢！$10"/pause 300/playMusic kindadumbautumn/faceDirection Harvey 1 true/move Harvey 2 0 1/speak Harvey "天啊，我的脈搏快得不得了……$7"/pause 400/playSound doorClose/warp farmer 6 12/move farmer 0 -3 0/faceDirection Harvey 2/speak Harvey "@！"/question fork1 "#問哈維為什麼如此慌張。#假裝一切正常。"/fork normal/pause 500/speak Harvey "啊，嗯……你瞧，我剛才在用這臺無線電……而且聯絡上了真正的飛行員！"/emote Harvey 16/speak Harvey "其實，現在大概就能看到他從頭頂飛過！"/move Harvey 0 1 3/move Harvey -3 0 0/move Harvey 0 -2 0/speak Harvey "快，過來！"/speed farmer 4/move farmer 0 -3 3/speed farmer 4/move farmer -4 0 0/speed farmer 4/move farmer 0 -2 0/speed farmer 4/speak Harvey "快看！"/globalFade/cutscene plane/viewport -1000 -1000/speak Harvey "小時候，我一直夢想成為飛行員。"/pause 1000/speak Harvey "……但因為視力不好，又極度懼高，那個夢想逐漸離我遠去。$s"/faceDirection Harvey 3/faceDirection farmer 1/viewport 5 6 true/pause 1600/emote farmer 28/speak Harvey "沒關係……別難過。#$b#我已經學會接受自己在生活中的位置。不是每個人都能實現夢想……這世界就是如此。"/pause 1600/speak Harvey "嘿，讓我帶你看看模型飛機。我剛完成新的TR-Starbird豪華套組。$h"/advancedMove Harvey false 0 2 16 0/faceDirection farmer 2/globalFade .003/viewport -1000 -1000/pause 500/end
